ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 80% high-intensity white/off-white pixels vs 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white high-intensity region spanning the central lobes. Dark low-intensity pigmentation concentrated on the trailing edges and median notch. Distinct vertical black linear streaks localized on the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the visible vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing boundary; irregular profile showing multiple fine peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a convex outer curve with a slightly concave trailing section; right lobe shows a predominantly linear, slightly convex trajectory ending in a sharp distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-intensity, roughly circular calcified pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct vertical, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on the left lobe tip; vertical linear pigment disruptions on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between distal tips; right tip is sharply tapered while left tip is rounded and encrusted with biological attachments.
